key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr thermal spray coatings, HVOF and HVAF produce the best wear performance, while HVAF delivers the strongest corrosion resistance.
engineering_relevance: The study helps select spray processes for extending the life of stainless-steel components exposed to wear and corrosive environments.
method: WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were deposited on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF, and HVAF.
Microstructure, Vickers hardness, tribological behavior, and electrochemical corrosion performance were compared across the four processes.
Wear tracks and failure modes were examined to identify dominant mechanisms such as abrasive and fatigue wear.
evidence_signal: Compared with bare 304 stainless steel, all coatings increased hardness and reduced wear rate, with HVAF showing the lowest wear rate and best corrosion metrics in the abstract.
watch_item: Results depend on the specific spray parameters and test conditions, so process optimization and adhesion/density checks are still needed before scale-up.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
